red_flag_rules.name: Chest pain with sweating / radiation
red_flag_rules.description: Acute coronary syndrome or myocardial infarction warning signs
red_flag_rules.reason: Red-flag: chest pain with sweating or radiating discomfort

red_flag_rules.name: Severe difficulty breathing
red_flag_rules.description: Acute respiratory distress, severe stridor, or cyanosis

red_flag_rules.name: Acute stroke signs (FAST criteria)
red_flag_rules.description: Facial droop, arm weakness, or speech difficulty of sudden onset

red_flag_rules.name: Loss of consciousness / unresponsiveness
red_flag_rules.description: Coma, syncope with prolonged loss of consciousness, or Glasgow Coma Scale drop

red_flag_rules.name: Active or prolonged seizure
red_flag_rules.description: Status epilepticus, repetitive convulsions, or ongoing active fitting
red_flag_rules.reason: Red-flag: active continuous seizure or convulsions

red_flag_rules.name: Severe allergic reaction / Anaphylaxis
red_flag_rules.description: Swelling of tongue/throat, hives combined with wheezing or hypotension
red_flag_rules.reason: Red-flag: severe allergic reaction or anaphylaxis warning

red_flag_rules.name: High risk of self-harm or suicidal intent
red_flag_rules.description: Expressed active suicidal ideation or intentional self-injury
red_flag_rules.reason: Red-flag: imminent self-harm or acute crisis
